Platform & Workflow Tools

L H
LAB
Local test execution

Local Jenkins

BTS Lab PC · TARGET_STAND agent
Live
BTS Lab PC — orchestration host on bench
Role: Runs all automated test pipelines against live BTS/CPE hardware. Not used for FW storage.
  • Email notification + publishHTML per build
  • Archives reports to reports/artifacts/
HQ
Firmware release hub

HQ Jenkins

Headquarters · release builds
Live
HQ infrastructure — FW artifact repository
Role: Builds and stores official firmware releases. Lab pulls FW images from HQ for flash & REG_03 upgrade tests.
  • Official firmware release builds
  • Versioned FW artifacts for validation
  • Consumed by lab during regression (REG_03)
  • Separate from local test execution Jenkins
Primary codebase

Atlantis — GitLab

AutomationTestBed repository
Live
Source of truth for automation code & configs
Role: Hosts the automation framework, YAML profiles, Jenkins Groovy pipelines, and test code. Also used for defect tracking & patch workflow.
  • Automation framework source (pytest, utils, traffic/)
  • profiles/*.yaml — lab topology & device config
  • jenkins/ — 3 pipeline definitions + common.groovy
  • GitLab issues — raise, track, close defects
  • Branch history · merge requests · code review
Test case management

Kiwi TCMS

Plans · runs · results · defects
Live
Central test plan & execution tracking
Role: Integrates with Jenkins/pytest to sync automated run results alongside manual test execution.
  • Test plans, suites & case catalog (GUI, IP, throughput)
  • Manual & automated execution status
  • Run history per firmware build
  • Export for release sign-off & stakeholder reports
  • Defect linkage with GitLab issues

Traffic & Performance

Traffic generator

TRex Server

Dedicated host · 3 NICs
Live
Mgmt → BTS switch · Data 1 → BTS switch · Data 2 → CPE switch
Module: traffic/trex_runner.py · performance_matrix.py · jenkins-Throughput
  • 192 combinations — HT20–HT160 × MCS × DL/UL ratios
  • SSH control from BTS Lab PC (mgmt NIC)
  • Operating-rate cross-check vs throughput spec
  • HTML + CSV + JSON per matrix run
  • Throughput PNG charts on TRex host
Benchmark · RFC

Ixia Novus MiniPro

IxNetwork REST API
Live
BTS-side LAN · selectable via profile (benchmark_backend: ixia)
Module: traffic/throughput_runner.py · ixnetwork_restpy
  • RFC 2544 / Y.1564 compliant sessions
  • Multi-CPE throughput benchmark
  • PDF performance report generation
  • Profile-selectable vs TRex backend
Bandwidth tool

iPerf3

End-to-end throughput
Live
BTS / CPE lab PCs · DUT as endpoints
Module: utils/iperf_lab_flows.py · IP suite (IP_18+)
  • IPv4 & IPv6 bandwidth validation
  • BTS ↔ CPE over RF path measurement
  • Integrated in functional IP test cases
  • Server endpoints defined in YAML profiles
